snapshot.scope: Anything convertible into Commons capability or value, including Bryce, devices, subscriptions, models, agents, tools, repositories, builds, data, attention, and external roads.
snapshot.truth_rule: Capacity, authority, lifecycle stage, and condition are independent. Declared or cached is not live; reset is not permission; activity is not value.
snapshot.privacy_rule: Public pointers, aggregate quotas, and operating state only. No tokens, credentials, private file names, personal account identifiers, raw model weights, or legal identity data.

subject: MASTER RESOURCE LEDGER — inventory is not utilization

priority_queue.activation: Bind one separately running named peer and prove wake to callback to durable DONE to quiet next tick.
Give the landed Windows surface one bounded benign actuation consumer and receipt.
Force unresolved claims and reservations to LANDED, BLOCKED, or RELEASED.
Repair exact-head health and run one SHA-pinned safe canary on each configured external CI road.
Route one concrete Commons discovery or evidence backlog through the live endpoint; do not redeploy it.
Monitor eight unique deliveries without resending; on a positive reply create acceptance proof, then a Bryce-controlled invoice.
Represent duplicate paths as content-addressed aliases so logical volume is not mistaken for new capacity.

hands_off: Claude as tester, verifier, reviewer, or landing authority
Titan model mutation until canonical span and recovery packet are owner-approved
financial, identity, account, or physical-device writes without exact owner scope
production deployment merely to consume quota
